scope: Three rendered D3D12 frames from the controlled loadout automation fixture. Human visual inspection verifies displayed menu and weapon/ammunition states. Frozen AI and fixture camera placement; no normal gameplay, hit-feel, performance or fun acceptance.
observations: ArsenalOpen: complete menu fits the frame; weapon labels, statistics and secondary reservation note are readable. Preparing Shaders (1) and a small console hint remain visible, so this is not polished visual-quality evidence.
PrimaryAfterSecondary: PRIMARY 2 / Phasma Rifle, ammunition 06/030 and the Phasma viewmodel agree with the asserted return state.
SamePrimaryReturn: PRIMARY 1 / Gale Repeater, ammunition 22/144 and Gale viewmodel agree with the fixture's explicit numbered selection; this is not an automatic weapon switch.
HUD text fits, but the small dense footer, bright glare and oversized prototype geometry remain presentation limitations. Both gameplay frames use the fixture camera pointed upward near a station.
